albane noble rue de la paix — eau de par.description: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix by Parisis Parfums begins right at the top with notes of brilliant red berries and the wild, sweet scent of bergamot, offering just a touch of lavender. The heart of the fragrance delights with notes of jasmine sambac and delicate Turkish rose. The base is deep and robust with its strong notes of patchouli, musk, sandalwood, cedarwood, amber, and oakmoss.
